keywords.indexterm: outside rearview mirror folding the outside rearview mirror

conbody.p: The outside rearview mirror can be folded or unfolded by pressing the switch when the EV button is in the POWER ON or DRIVE READY position as below.

li.p: To fold the outside rearview mirror depress the button.
To unfold it, depress the button again.

note.p: The electric type outside rearview mirror operates even though the EV button is in the OFF position. However, to prevent unnecessary battery discharge, do not adjust the mirrors longer than necessary while the vehicle is not running.
In case it is an electric type outside rearview mirror, don't fold it by hand. It could cause motor failure.
